name: Xu Weihao
bio: Director, screenwriter, and actor, originally from Jiangsu and raised in Beijing. In 2023, White River, which he co-wrote and starred in, was selected for the Bright Future section of the 52nd International Film Festival Rotterdam and was theatrically released in France in January 2025. In 2026, Against the Flow, in which he stars, was selected for the International Narrative Competition of the 25th Tribeca Festival. His directorial debut Last Train was selected for the Golden Goblet Short Film Competition at the 28th Shanghai International Film Festival

credits.title: Last Train
credits.overview: Baiye is a small border town where trains run through each day, heading toward the other side. Now nearly deserted, silent and still, the town is a place people rarely return to once they leave. One day, a young woman arrives with ashes, on her way to visit a mother.
